label: Optimizing-giving laws and a tied-optimum model, checked
meaning: Premise-free: five laws (stability under the giving-output adapter is fixity; a unique optimum makes a root fixed toward every effect and two-way toward none, so it cannot be a mixed-mode root; with SS a unique-optimum root exercising a rational power toward another given being makes WN fail; a unique-optimum root gives being to at most one being at w; with (b1) and reach it leaves at most one actual concretum besides itself) and two models (the tied optimum; the mediated optimum, where the rival holds without direct reach). Model-witnessed separations only; no premise is established and no reality claim is made.
